pages.text: $(l)Just Enough Items$() gets two extra recipe categories from MC3DPrint.$(br2)The first shows what any item costs to $(l)print$(): its Filament Unit price and the machine tier it needs.$(br2)The second shows what is $(l)inside$() a Blueprint Disc, so you can check a build's contents before printing it.

$(l)Patchouli$() is what you are reading. The Fabricator's Handbook is craftable from an $(item)Extrudium Crystal$() and a $(item)Book$(), or handed out with $(l)/mc3dprint guide$().$(br2)Both are optional. Without JEI you lose the lookup, not the mechanic; without Patchouli there is no book, and nothing else changes.
pages.title: The Handbook
